title: Efficient Ammonia Synthesis over a Core-shell Ru/CeO2 Catalyst with Tunable CeO2 Size: DFT Calculation and XAS Spectroscopy Studies
extraction_notes: The supplied SI contains characterization figures and a mass-transfer calculation only. It does not report any NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF under stated reaction conditions. The mass-transfer section gives an observed nitrogen reaction rate (2 x 10^-7 kmol-N2/(kg-cat·s)) for Ru@CeO2-9, but this is not reported as an NH3 formation rate and lacks the reaction conditions required for a catalyst-performance entry.
